summary.name: Glyph Studio (Prevail)
summary.one_liner: A local-first AI harness for personal life management that keeps your life data as plain files on your computer and lets you use different AI models for different life areas.
use_cases: Keep personal health, money, work and home notes in one private folder
Get several AI models to answer a major decision and compare their views
Run AI entirely on local models so data stays on the machine
Test which AI model performs best on your own questions
Back up or move personal AI memory as plain files
summary.what_it_does: Glyph Studio builds and runs an AI harness on your computer. A lead agent answers first, and specialist agents weigh in on the same question. A council mode sends one decision to several models, and a chair model writes a verdict noting where they disagreed. Each life domain (such as health, money, work, or home) keeps its own memory and can use its own AI model. Your vault is a folder of plain files that you can open, back up, or move. Bunker Mode runs entirely on local models, while Cloud Mode uses frontier models you choose.
notable: Councils: multiple models answer one decision and a chair model writes a verdict
Per-domain memory and model choice for areas like health, money, work and home
Bunker Mode runs fully on local models via Ollama; no telemetry by default
Open source under GPL-3.0; the listing says it is signed and notarized for Mac
caveats: Page does not state paid tiers or costs beyond the listing's 'Freeware' label
Cloud Mode relies on third-party frontier models you choose, which may have their own costs
Linux and WSL are only covered by the CLI, not the desktop app
